description: The deputy's own question frame (mood, subject, verb) from the native UD parse, with a subject-as-root repair for present polar questions.
state: Pure function of one sentence's native words.
forward: mood from the first words; subject/verb from root, nsubj, acl/amod/xcomp or compound; repaired flag.

repair_imperative: no VERB/AUX/nsubj, first word NOUN/NN base form, a configured request predicate, heading no det/amod/nummod/case/nmod:poss -> VERB/VB root, old root its obj; read_repairing marks the frame repaired. Compound subject under a polar predicate includes nested premodifiers (2026-11-05).
inverse: A frame names a set of compatible sentences, not the text.
checks: 2026-11-04: frame unit tests on real native parses with negative controls; repair removal turns frame and native deputy tests red.

2026-11-05: imperative repair unit tests on the en.bin 2483516a parse with five negative controls; native deputy test plans "Show Crab's (recent) reports."; removing the repair turns one unit and two native tests red (restored).
limitations: No embedded questions, coordination, passive or non-inverted questions; a frame is not a parse-quality verdict.
